political_categories.name: Economy & Finance
political_categories.scope: Bills about taxation, business and corporate regulation, financial markets, monetary policy, and trade.
political_categories.conservative_view: Free markets, lower taxes, minimal regulation, fiscal responsibility
political_categories.liberal_view: Government regulation, progressive taxation, consumer protections, address inequality

subcategories.name: Taxes
subcategories.scope: Income, corporate, estate, and wealth tax policy; tax credits and deductions.
subcategories.conservative_view: Lower taxes stimulate growth and reduce government size
subcategories.liberal_view: Progressive taxation funds public services and reduces inequality

subcategories.name: Business Regulation
subcategories.scope: Antitrust, corporate governance, consumer protection, and market concentration.
subcategories.conservative_view: Minimal regulation allows innovation naturally
subcategories.liberal_view: Strong regulation prevents monopoly abuse and protects consumers

subcategories.name: Financial Markets & Monetary Policy
subcategories.scope: Securities and banking regulation, the Federal Reserve, crypto, and inflation control.
subcategories.conservative_view: Sound money, price stability, light-touch capital regulation
subcategories.liberal_view: Strong Wall Street oversight prevents fraud and systemic risk

subcategories.name: Trade & Tariffs
subcategories.scope: Tariffs, trade agreements, import and export rules, and trade enforcement.
subcategories.conservative_view: Aggressive tariffs to protect domestic manufacturing
subcategories.liberal_view: Free trade benefits all but requires strict labor standards

political_categories.name: Budget & Appropriations
political_categories.scope: Budget resolutions, appropriations bills, continuing resolutions, the debt limit, and rescissions.
political_categories.conservative_view: Fiscal discipline, balanced budgets, limited spending
political_categories.liberal_view: Strategic investment, social programs, less deficit concern

subcategories.name: Debt & Deficit
subcategories.scope: Debt ceiling, deficit reduction measures, and rescissions.
subcategories.conservative_view: Reduce debt, strict spending cuts
subcategories.liberal_view: Debt is acceptable for productive investments

subcategories.name: Appropriations
subcategories.scope: Annual and omnibus appropriations, continuing resolutions, and supplemental spending.
subcategories.conservative_view: Streamlined funding, strict oversight to eliminate waste
subcategories.liberal_view: Adequate funding for comprehensive government services

political_categories.name: Labor & Employment
political_categories.scope: Worker protections, union rights, wages, and workplace conditions.
political_categories.conservative_view: Market forces determine wages, right-to-work laws
political_categories.liberal_view: Strong unions, living wage laws, robust worker safety nets

subcategories.name: Unions & Collective Bargaining
subcategories.scope: Organized labor rights, strike protections, right-to-work laws.
subcategories.conservative_view: Protect right-to-work, voluntary unionization
subcategories.liberal_view: Strong unions are essential to balance corporate power

subcategories.name: Wages & Benefits
subcategories.scope: Minimum wage, paid leave, overtime rules.
subcategories.conservative_view: Market-driven wages, avoid mandated benefits
subcategories.liberal_view: Federal minimum wage increases, mandated paid leave

subcategories.name: Workplace Safety & Standards
subcategories.scope: OSHA regulations, discrimination in employment, worker classification.
subcategories.conservative_view: Flexible labor arrangements, avoid burdensome compliance
subcategories.liberal_view: Strict enforcement, prevent misclassification of workers

political_categories.name: Healthcare
political_categories.scope: Healthcare coverage, costs, public health, and health regulation.

subcategories.name: Coverage Models
subcategories.scope: Universal healthcare vs private insurance systems.
subcategories.conservative_view: Private insurance provides better quality and choice
subcategories.liberal_view: Universal healthcare ensures access for everyone

subcategories.name: Costs & Access
subcategories.scope: Drug pricing, insurance affordability, billing transparency.
subcategories.conservative_view: Competition reduces costs naturally; avoid price controls
subcategories.liberal_view: Government intervention is needed to control excessive pricing

subcategories.name: Public & Mental Health
subcategories.scope: Pandemic response, vaccinations, suicide prevention, parity laws.
subcategories.conservative_view: Individual choice, private sector innovation
subcategories.liberal_view: Government coordination, adequate state funding

subcategories.name: Reproductive Health
subcategories.scope: Abortion policy, contraception access, maternal care.
subcategories.conservative_view: Protect unborn life, religious freedom for providers
subcategories.liberal_view: Women's bodily autonomy, universal reproductive choice

political_categories.name: Education
political_categories.scope: Schools, universities, student support, and education policy.
political_categories.conservative_view: School choice, parental rights, local control
political_categories.liberal_view: Equitable public funding, teacher support, inclusion

subcategories.name: K-12 Education
subcategories.scope: Funding, curriculum standards, teacher pay.
subcategories.conservative_view: Local control, merit pay, focus on core subjects
subcategories.liberal_view: Adequate funding, inclusive curriculum, professional compensation

subcategories.name: Higher Education
subcategories.scope: Student loans, tuition, public university funding.
subcategories.conservative_view: Personal responsibility for costs, reduce subsidies
subcategories.liberal_view: Accessible through public funding and loan forgiveness

subcategories.name: School Choice
subcategories.scope: Charter schools, vouchers, homeschooling policy.
subcategories.conservative_view: Competition improves quality, funding follows the student
subcategories.liberal_view: Fully support public schools, avoid diverting funds to private entities

political_categories.name: Infrastructure & Transportation
political_categories.scope: Physical and digital infrastructure, transportation systems, and public utilities.
political_categories.conservative_view: Private sector efficiency, user fees, core infrastructure
political_categories.liberal_view: Major public investment, economic stimulus, equitable access

subcategories.name: Transportation
subcategories.scope: Roads, transit systems, aviation, maritime.
subcategories.conservative_view: User fees, private sector, focus on roads and highways
subcategories.liberal_view: Public investment in mass transit and sustainable options

subcategories.name: Digital Infrastructure
subcategories.scope: Broadband expansion, rural connectivity.
subcategories.conservative_view: Private sector expansion, market competition drives access
subcategories.liberal_view: Universal access ensured through heavy government investment

subcategories.name: Public Works & Utilities
subcategories.scope: Water systems, electricity grid, waste management.
subcategories.conservative_view: Private utility management, user fees, market mechanisms
subcategories.liberal_view: Public utilities ensure universal access and affordability

political_categories.name: Environment & Energy
political_categories.scope: Natural resources, energy production, climate change, conservation, and disaster management.
political_categories.conservative_view: Economic growth, energy independence, market solutions
political_categories.liberal_view: Aggressive climate action, renewables, environmental protection

subcategories.name: Climate Policy
subcategories.scope: Emissions limits, carbon pricing, green incentives.
subcategories.conservative_view: Market technological solutions, avoid economic disruption
subcategories.liberal_view: Urgent regulation, carbon pricing, rapid transition mandates

subcategories.name: Energy Production
subcategories.scope: Fossil fuels, nuclear power, renewable energy.
subcategories.conservative_view: All-of-the-above strategy including domestic fossil fuels
subcategories.liberal_view: Rapid transition to renewable sources, phase out fossil fuels

subcategories.name: Conservation & Water
subcategories.scope: Public lands, wildlife, water rights, pollution control.
subcategories.conservative_view: Balance use for economic benefit, respect property rights
subcategories.liberal_view: Strong protection, prioritize conservation over resource extraction

subcategories.name: Disaster Management
subcategories.scope: FEMA programs, hurricane/wildfire response.
subcategories.conservative_view: State local response, personal responsibility for preparedness
subcategories.liberal_view: Strong federal response, fund climate change adaptation

political_categories.name: Science & Technology
political_categories.scope: Digital platforms, data security, artificial intelligence, scientific research, and space.
political_categories.conservative_view: Light regulation, innovation leadership, free speech online
political_categories.liberal_view: Strong regulation, data privacy, algorithmic accountability

subcategories.name: Data Privacy & Cybersecurity
subcategories.scope: Corporate and consumer data protection and cybersecurity. Government surveillance belongs in Civil Rights & Social Issues > Government Surveillance & Privacy.
subcategories.conservative_view: Market solutions, private partnerships without heavy burdens
subcategories.liberal_view: Strong federal data protection laws, strict cyber mandates

subcategories.name: Tech Regulation & Speech
subcategories.scope: Online content moderation, platform liability.
subcategories.conservative_view: Protect free speech, avoid censorship by platforms
subcategories.liberal_view: Platform responsibility to combat harm and misinformation

subcategories.name: Emerging Tech & AI
subcategories.scope: Artificial intelligence, biotech, intellectual property.
subcategories.conservative_view: Minimal regulation to maintain US technological leadership
subcategories.liberal_view: Proactive regulation to ensure safety and prevent bias

subcategories.name: Space & Scientific Research
subcategories.scope: NASA programs, federal R&D funding.
subcategories.conservative_view: Space commercialization, defense-focused basic research
subcategories.liberal_view: Robust public funding for institutions, peaceful exploration

political_categories.name: Agriculture & Rural Issues
political_categories.scope: Farmers, food safety, and rural economies.
political_categories.conservative_view: Farming autonomy, minimal regulation, market solutions
political_categories.liberal_view: Sustainability, worker protections, support small farms

subcategories.name: Farm Policy
subcategories.scope: Subsidies, crop insurance, agribusiness regulation.
subcategories.conservative_view: Market programs, reduce regulatory burden on family farms
subcategories.liberal_view: Restructure subsidies to support sustainability and small farms

subcategories.name: Food Safety
subcategories.scope: Labeling, inspection, GMO policy.
subcategories.conservative_view: Science-based safety, agricultural innovation, minimal labeling
subcategories.liberal_view: Strong FDA/USDA oversight, aggressive consumer right-to-know

subcategories.name: Rural Development
subcategories.scope: Infrastructure and healthcare access for rural areas.
subcategories.conservative_view: Market solutions, empower local community autonomy
subcategories.liberal_view: Targeted federal investment to ensure equitable healthcare and access

political_categories.name: Criminal Justice
political_categories.scope: Criminal law, sentencing, policing, prisons, reentry, and drug enforcement.
political_categories.conservative_view: Tough on crime, strong enforcement, victims' rights
political_categories.liberal_view: Reform system, rehabilitation, reduce mass incarceration

subcategories.name: Sentencing & Punishment
subcategories.scope: Prison terms, mandatory minimums, death penalty.
subcategories.conservative_view: Serious punishment deters crime and incapacitates offenders
subcategories.liberal_view: Reduce sentences, eliminate mandatory minimums

subcategories.name: Policing & Law Enforcement
subcategories.scope: Police funding, tactics, accountability.
subcategories.conservative_view: Support and fully fund police, maintain qualified immunity
subcategories.liberal_view: Reform through strict accountability and independent oversight

subcategories.name: Rehabilitation & Drug Policy
subcategories.scope: Prison programs, decriminalization, treatment.
subcategories.conservative_view: Punishment is primary, maintain strong drug enforcement
subcategories.liberal_view: Decriminalize minor offenses, treat addiction as a health issue

political_categories.name: Civil Rights & Social Issues
political_categories.scope: Civil rights, anti-discrimination, family and religious issues, government surveillance and privacy, and tribal affairs.
political_categories.conservative_view: Traditional values, colorblind equality, religious freedom
political_categories.liberal_view: Active social justice, equity, protect marginalized groups

subcategories.name: Civil Rights & Equity
subcategories.scope: Anti-discrimination laws, affirmative action.
subcategories.conservative_view: Equal opportunity and colorblind legal treatment
subcategories.liberal_view: Active measures needed to combat systemic discrimination

subcategories.name: Family, Culture & Religion
subcategories.scope: Marriage policy, gender identity, religious liberties.
subcategories.conservative_view: Traditional family structures, robust religious exemptions
subcategories.liberal_view: Marriage equality, LGBTQ+ rights, secular governance

subcategories.name: Government Surveillance & Privacy
subcategories.scope: Government data collection, warrants, and surveillance authorities. Corporate data privacy belongs in Science & Technology > Data Privacy & Cybersecurity; foreign intelligence operations belong in Defense & National Security > Intelligence & Counterterrorism.
subcategories.conservative_view: Balance civil liberties with law enforcement and security needs
subcategories.liberal_view: Robust privacy protections, absolute defense of individual rights

subcategories.name: Tribal & Indigenous Affairs
subcategories.scope: Native American sovereignty, treaty rights, cultural preservation.
subcategories.conservative_view: Balance tribal sovereignty with federal/state authority
subcategories.liberal_view: Strictly honor treaties, strong support for self-determination

political_categories.name: Immigration
political_categories.scope: Border security, legal immigration, asylum, and refugee policy.
political_categories.conservative_view: Strict enforcement, merit-based, robust border security
political_categories.liberal_view: Humane system, pathways to citizenship, family unity

subcategories.name: Border Security & Enforcement
subcategories.scope: Physical barriers, ICE operations, deportation.
subcategories.conservative_view: Physical barriers, strict deportation laws to deter crossings
subcategories.liberal_view: Smart border technology, limit interior ICE raids

subcategories.name: Legal Immigration & Pathways
subcategories.scope: Visas, green cards, DACA, amnesty.
subcategories.conservative_view: Skills-based system, oppose blanket amnesty
subcategories.liberal_view: Permanent pathway to citizenship for undocumented populations

subcategories.name: Asylum & Refugees
subcategories.scope: Humanitarian protection, asylum claims.
subcategories.conservative_view: Tighten asylum rules, limit overall refugee admissions for security
subcategories.liberal_view: Restore asylum processes, generous refugee admissions

political_categories.name: Defense & National Security
political_categories.scope: The military, veterans, intelligence, and homeland security.
political_categories.conservative_view: Peace through strength, robust funding, decisive capability
political_categories.liberal_view: Measured spending, focus on diplomacy and asymmetric threats

subcategories.name: Military Readiness & Budget
subcategories.scope: Pentagon funding, weapons procurement.
subcategories.conservative_view: Consistent defense spending increases for global supremacy
subcategories.liberal_view: Audit the bloated budget, reallocate funds to domestic needs

subcategories.name: Veterans Affairs
subcategories.scope: VA hospitals, military benefits.
subcategories.conservative_view: Expand private healthcare choices to bypass VA wait times
subcategories.liberal_view: Fully fund and staff the VA system as a public healthcare model

subcategories.name: Intelligence & Counterterrorism
subcategories.scope: Foreign intelligence operations, the CIA and NSA, and homeland security operations.
subcategories.conservative_view: Provide agencies broad authorities to prevent attacks
subcategories.liberal_view: Strict congressional oversight to prevent rights violations

political_categories.name: Foreign Policy
political_categories.scope: Diplomacy, alliances and treaties, foreign aid, and sanctions.
political_categories.conservative_view: America First, bilateral agreements, national interests
political_categories.liberal_view: Multilateral cooperation, human rights, global stability

subcategories.name: International Alliances & Treaties
subcategories.scope: NATO, the UN, and other international organizations and treaties, including climate accords.
subcategories.conservative_view: Alliances must explicitly serve US interests and sovereignty
subcategories.liberal_view: Strong alliances multiply influence and solve global crises

subcategories.name: Foreign Aid & Diplomacy
subcategories.scope: Humanitarian relief, State Department funding, diplomacy, and sanctions.
subcategories.conservative_view: Highly restricted aid tied to direct strategic objectives
subcategories.liberal_view: Robust diplomacy funding promotes stability and builds alliances

political_categories.name: Government Operations & Reform
political_categories.scope: Elections, campaign finance and ethics, and the structure and balance of government powers.
political_categories.conservative_view: Limited federal power, originalism, election integrity
political_categories.liberal_view: Democratic reforms, voting access, institutional accountability

subcategories.name: Electoral Law & Voting
subcategories.scope: Voter ID, ballot access, gerrymandering.
subcategories.conservative_view: Election integrity requires strict voter ID and state control
subcategories.liberal_view: Expand access through federal standards and automatic registration

subcategories.name: Campaign Finance & Ethics
subcategories.scope: PACs, political donations, lobbying rules.
subcategories.conservative_view: Political spending is protected free speech
subcategories.liberal_view: Aggressive reform to limit corporate influence, public financing

subcategories.name: Separation of Powers & Intergovernmental Relations
subcategories.scope: Agency authority, executive orders, war, tariff and spending authority, and federal-state relations.
subcategories.conservative_view: Decentralize power to states, rein in the administrative state
subcategories.liberal_view: Strong federal authority ensures equal protection nationwide
